decision_question: Can the frozen six-engine program execute through a release or redesign decision without a harness, identity, leakage, or accounting defect?

hard_gates.name: harness-validity
hard_gates.evidence: The direct-DeepSeek binding omitted provider_user_id and raised KeyError in four concurrent local calls before network I/O.

hard_gates.name: downstream-stages-remain-closed
hard_gates.evidence: Autonomy, sealed confirmation, known regression, proxy synthesis, and local release qualification remained pending.

hard_gates.name: quality-result-not-interpreted
hard_gates.evidence: The development stage never completed and produced no Keep/Refine selection.

failures.evidence: DeepSeek call construction raised KeyError: provider_user_id before network I/O.

decision.rationale: Preserve attempt 001, use the one preregistered harness-only correction to add a fixed privacy-safe provider user ID, and execute one final fresh attempt without changing the method or gates.

limitations: No development or product-quality conclusion is valid from this incomplete attempt.
The p95 latency is recorded as zero because the invalid attempt did not produce a complete cross-engine latency distribution suitable for interpretation.
The first three provider-backed engines incurred cost but are not reused as confirmatory evidence.
The ordinary GPT-5.4-nano failed response is preserved separately from the four harness failures.
